2. Burnham opens door to tax rises, owns £4.7bn defence gap, in first leadership interview (BBC/Sky/Times front page — confirmed)

All five covered in retrievals. Broad sweeps run: "world news today", "UK news today", BBC UK homepage top-5 audit (07:20 BST).
Notable exclusions: pubs 5am World Cup story (sport-adjacent, vetoed — led five tabloid front pages); NHS walking vouchers (20 vs 30 min discrepancy unresolved); MAFS star arrest (celebrity); Khamenei funeral curtain-raiser (single full source; covered last night); CSIS casualty study (single source — used as One To Read link only); Guardian 10,000-jobs analysis (folded into Burnham item with BBC papers corroboration).
